questions.explanation: 结合前半句“Like a rock to a piece of glass”（就像石头砸向玻璃），生动比喻了这句话对作者信念的“摧毁”。ruin 意为“毁坏，摧毁”，符合语境逻辑。establish 建立；restore 恢复；correct 纠正。
questions.supplement:
A(ruined)：语境句：The scandal completely ruined his reputation. 固定搭配：ruin one's health / reputation
B(established)：语境句：The company was established in 1890. 固定搭配：establish a relationship / a rule
C(restored)：语境句：The old church was beautifully restored. 固定搭配：restore one's health / sight
D(corrected)：语境句：He corrected the mistakes in his essay. 固定搭配：correct a mistake / an error

questions.explanation: 由于信念被摧毁，作者的自信心也随之“消退”并消失在黑暗中。fade 意为“逐渐消失，消退”，fade into the blackness 形象表达了自信的丧失。expand 扩大；flow 流动；pour 倾泻。
questions.supplement:
A(faded)：语境句：The sound of the music slowly faded away. 固定搭配：fade away / fade into darkness
B(expanded)：语境句：The business expanded rapidly into new markets. 固定搭配：expand one's business / horizons
C(flowed)：语境句：The river flowed gently into the sea. 固定搭配：flow into / flow through
D(poured)：语境句：She poured a cup of tea for me. 固定搭配：pour out / pour down

questions.explanation: 作者把那些话埋在记忆深处，因为生活用各种任务、目标和成就“取代”了它们。replace A with B 意为“用B替换A”。combine 结合；load 装载；present 呈现。
questions.supplement:
A(combined)：语境句：We combined the two departments to improve efficiency. 固定搭配：combine A with B / combined with
B(loaded)：语境句：The workers loaded the truck with boxes. 固定搭配：load A with B / load up
C(presented)：语境句：He presented the prize to the winner. 固定搭配：present sb with sth / present sth to sb
D(replaced)：语境句：I replaced the old battery with a new one. 固定搭配：replace A with B / replace the broken parts

questions.explanation: 前文说到生活如同日复一日播放的电影般平静，但随后却“出乎意料地”失控了（被查出癌症）。unexpectedly 意为“意外地，出乎意料地”，形成剧情转折。unhurriedly 不慌不忙地；unreasonably 不合理地；unaffectedly 自然地。
questions.supplement:
A(unhurriedly)：语境句：He walked unhurriedly towards the train station. 固定搭配：act unhurriedly / move unhurriedly
B(unexpectedly)：语境句：He arrived unexpectedly in the middle of the night. 固定搭配：happen unexpectedly / die unexpectedly
C(unreasonably)：语境句：She was acting unreasonably about the short delay. 固定搭配：behave unreasonably / complain unreasonably
D(unaffectedly)：语境句：She spoke unaffectedly about her difficult childhood. 固定搭配：behave unaffectedly / smile unaffectedly

questions.explanation: 冒号后的内容“You have cancer.”（你得癌症了）对作者而言是一个突如其来的“消息”。news 意为“消息”。lesson 教训；post 岗位；advice 建议。
questions.supplement:
A(lesson)：语境句：His failure taught him a valuable lesson. 固定搭配：teach sb a lesson / learn a lesson
B(post)：语境句：He resigned from his post as general manager. 固定搭配：take up a post / leave one's post
C(news)：语境句：The news of his sudden death shocked everyone. 固定搭配：break the news / good news
D(advice)：语境句：I decided to follow my doctor's advice. 固定搭配：give advice / take one's advice

questions.explanation: 长达一年经历手术和并发症，这个过程必然是“令人疲惫不堪的，折磨人的”。wearing 意为“使人疲乏的，令人厌烦的”。promising 有希望的；amazing 令人惊叹的；inspiring 鼓舞人心的。
questions.supplement:
A(wearing)：语境句：Taking care of a sick child can be very wearing. 固定搭配：a wearing day / physically wearing
B(promising)：语境句：The young athlete has a promising future. 固定搭配：a promising start / a promising career
C(amazing)：语境句：The view from the top of the mountain was amazing. 固定搭配：an amazing experience / an amazing discovery
D(inspiring)：语境句：Her speech was truly inspiring to all the students. 固定搭配：an inspiring story / an inspiring leader

questions.explanation: 后文提到 mixed with interruptions of relapses（伴随着旧病复发的打断），说明旧病复发之间穿插着的是相对“平静”的时期。calm 意为“平静，安宁”。guilt 内疚；boredom 无聊；shame 羞愧。
questions.supplement:
A(guilt)：语境句：He was consumed by guilt after lying to his friend. 固定搭配：feel guilt / a sense of guilt
B(boredom)：语境句：She complained of boredom during the long holiday. 固定搭配：die of boredom / relieve boredom
C(calm)：语境句：The sea was calm after the violent storm passed. 固定搭配：keep calm / a period of calm
D(shame)：语境句：He hung his head in shame when caught cheating. 固定搭配：feel shame / bring shame on

questions.explanation: 在长达半个世纪的人生斗争中，作者曾多次“回想起”童年时被嘲笑的那些糟糕的话。recall 意为“回想，回忆起”。coin 创造新词；process 加工；spell 拼写/招致。
questions.supplement:
A(coined)：语境句：He coined a new term for this social phenomenon. 固定搭配：coin a word / coin a phrase
B(recalled)：语境句：She recalled seeing him outside the coffee shop. 固定搭配：recall doing sth / recall a memory
C(processed)：语境句：The factory processed raw materials into finished goods. 固定搭配：process data / process food
D(spelled)：语境句：Could you spell your surname for me please? 固定搭配：spell out / spell trouble

questions.explanation: 作者一生都在与癌症以及生活中的挑战作“斗争”。battles 意为“战斗，较量”，契合作者在病痛和逆境中抗争的语境。expectation 期望；dream 梦想；tale 故事。
questions.supplement:
A(expectations)：语境句：The resort exceeded all our holiday expectations. 固定搭配：meet expectations / fall short of expectations
B(dreams)：语境句：She finally realized her childhood dreams. 固定搭配：chase one's dreams / a dream come true
C(tales)：语境句：Grandpa told us fascinating tales of his youth. 固定搭配：tell a tale / fairy tales
D(battles)：语境句：He lost his long battle against lung cancer. 固定搭配：fight a battle / win a battle

questions.explanation: 尽管多次想起那些负面的话，但因为信仰，作者从未让这些话使自己感到“绝望”。hopeless 意为“绝望的”。fearless 无畏的（感情色彩不对，作者希望无畏，不会“不允许自己无畏”）；speechless 无语的；heartless 无情的。
questions.supplement:
A(fearless)：语境句：The fearless firefighter ran into the burning building. 固定搭配：a fearless warrior / absolutely fearless
B(hopeless)：语境句：Without food and water, the situation seemed hopeless. 固定搭配：feel hopeless / a hopeless situation
C(speechless)：语境句：His rude and unexpected behavior left me speechless. 固定搭配：leave sb speechless / be speechless with anger
D(heartless)：语境句：It was a heartless thing to say to a crying child. 固定搭配：a heartless comment / seem heartless

questions.explanation: 生活中的每一个变故都成为一个探索新道路并“提醒”自己有多坚强果断的机会。remind 意为“提醒”。warn 警告；comfort 安慰；question 质疑。
questions.supplement:
A(warn)：语境句：They warned us not to walk alone in the dark alley. 固定搭配：warn sb about sth / warn sb not to do sth
B(comfort)：语境句：She tried to comfort her crying baby with a lullaby. 固定搭配：comfort sb with sth / seek comfort
C(remind)：语境句：Please remind me to call my mother tonight. 固定搭配：remind sb of sth / remind sb to do sth
D(question)：语境句：No one dared to question his final decision. 固定搭配：question one's motives / beyond question

questions.explanation: 朋友问作者：“你是如何坚持下去而不‘放弃’的？”。give up 意为“放弃”，与 keep going 形成对照，符合语义逻辑。get through 熬过；insist on 坚持；hold back 阻挡/克制。
questions.supplement:
A(get through)：语境句：I tried to call you, but I couldn't get through. 固定搭配：get through a difficult time / get through an exam
B(give up)：语境句：No matter how hard it gets, you should never give up. 固定搭配：give up hope / give up doing sth
C(insist on)：语境句：She insisted on paying for the dinner herself. 固定搭配：insist on doing sth / insist on one's rights
D(hold back)：语境句：He tried hard to hold back his tears during the movie. 固定搭配：hold back tears / hold sb back

questions.explanation: 朋友的问题瞬间把作者拉回到了她年轻时的那个“场景”（男孩嘲笑她的那一幕）。scene 意为“情景，场景”。fantasy 幻想；glory 荣耀；adventure 冒险。
questions.supplement:
A(scene)：语境句：The police arrived at the scene of the crime very quickly. 固定搭配：crime scene / behind the scenes
B(fantasy)：语境句：The young boy lived in a beautiful world of fantasy. 固定搭配：fantasy world / childhood fantasy
C(glory)：语境句：The victorious team returned home in a blaze of glory. 固定搭配：bring glory to / bathe in glory
D(adventure)：语境句：They set off on an exciting adventure across the ocean. 固定搭配：a sense of adventure / go on an adventure

questions.explanation: 那句原本伤人的话在作者心中忽然“具有了/蕴含了”新的意义。hold 意为“拥有，蕴含”，hold new meaning 意为“具有新意”。lay 放置；revise 修改；erase 抹去。
questions.supplement:
A(laid)：语境句：She laid the sleeping baby gently on the soft bed. 固定搭配：lay a solid foundation / lay the table
B(revised)：语境句：He revised his manuscript based on the editor's feedback. 固定搭配：revise a plan / revise for an exam
C(erased)：语境句：He erased the wrong answer and wrote the correct one. 固定搭配：erase a memory / erase a mistake
D(held)：语境句：These ancient traditions still hold great significance today. 固定搭配：hold meaning / hold a meeting / hold one's breath

questions.explanation: 首尾呼应，并升华主题：别人问她为何不放弃，她微笑着回答：“我之所以能‘活下来/战胜病魔’，正是因为我像女孩一样去战斗”。survive 意为“幸存，挺过难关”。withdraw 撤退；respond 回应；apologize 道歉。
questions.supplement:
A(withdraw)：语境句：He decided to withdraw from the competition due to injury. 固定搭配：withdraw from / withdraw cash
B(respond)：语境句：The patient didn't respond well to the new medical treatment. 固定搭配：respond to a question / respond quickly
C(survive)：语境句：Only a few people survived the terrible earthquake. 固定搭配：survive a disaster / survive on little money
D(apologize)：语境句：You should apologize to her for being late again. 固定搭配：apologize to sb for sth / sincerely apologize

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fight in a manner stereotypically associated with girls, often used as an insult but reclaimed as a sign of strength
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 像女孩一样打架（原为贬义，后被重新定义为坚强）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中作动词短语，出现在直接引语和句末，原形使用，表达一种反讽的坚强。
vocab_pack.example_en: She proved that fighting like a girl means never giving up.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她证明了像女孩一样战斗意味着永不放弃。
vocab_pack.from_passage: You fight like a girl!

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make or utter a statement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中deliver的现在分词形式，与that statement搭配，表示说出那句话。
vocab_pack.example_en: He delivered a powerful statement during the debate.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他在辩论中发表了一个强有力的声明。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The boy laughed as he ran away after delivering that statement.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to destroy someone's belief or confidence
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式ruined，后接宾语my belief，表示毁掉了我的信念。
vocab_pack.example_en: The failure ruined his belief in himself.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 失败摧毁了他对自己的信心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it ruined my belief that I could do anything that my male classmates could do

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gradually disappear into something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式faded，后接介词into短语，表示信心消失在黑暗中。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sound of the music faded into the distance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐声逐渐消失在远方。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my confidence faded into the blackness.

vocab_pack.term: bury in the depth of memory
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: buried those words in the depth of my memory
vocab_pack.definition_en: to hide or store something deep in one's memory
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式buried，后接宾语those words，介词短语in the depth of my memory作状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She buried the painful experience in the depth of her memory.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她把那段痛苦的经历深埋于记忆深处。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Through the years, I buried those words in the depth of my memory as life replaced them with tasks, goals and achievements.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take the place of something with something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式replaced，后接宾语them，with引出替换物。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should replace old bad habits with good ones.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该用好习惯取代旧坏习惯。
vocab_pack.from_passage: life replaced them with tasks, goals and achievements.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to disappear or dissolve gradually
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式melted，away表示消失，主语Days表示日子流逝。
vocab_pack.example_en: The snow melted away when spring came.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 春天来临时，雪融化了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Days melted away, and my life became a welcome movie that replayed daily but then unexpectedly ran out of control

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become impossible to manage or control
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式ran，out of control是固定习语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The situation quickly ran out of control.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 局势很快失控了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: but then unexpectedly ran out of control as I was met with the news

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive or encounter something (often news or reaction)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，was met with，后接the news，表示我收到消息。
vocab_pack.example_en: His suggestion was met with enthusiasm.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的建议得到了热烈的回应。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as I was met with the news: 'You have cancer.'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to suffer from the disease of cancer
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 直接引语中的一般现在时，主语You，have表示患病。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was devastated when she learned she had cancer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当她得知自己患有癌症时，她崩溃了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: You have cancer.

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing fatigue; exhausting
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，修饰year，源自动词wear的现在分词，这里已形容词化。
vocab_pack.example_en: It was a wearing journey across the desert.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那是一次穿越沙漠的令人疲惫的旅程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A(n) wearing year of surgeries and complications made my happy ending impossible.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a medical problem that develops during a disease or treatment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，与surgeries并列，指手术和并发症。
vocab_pack.example_en: The patient developed serious complications after the surgery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 病人手术后出现了严重的并发症。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A(n) wearing year of surgeries and complications

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to be unable to happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式made，后接宾语my happy ending，加形容词impossible作宾补。
vocab_pack.example_en: The heavy rain made our picnic impossible.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大雨使我们的野餐不可能进行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A(n) wearing year of surgeries and complications made my happy ending impossible.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to respond to a challenge by showing one's ability or effort
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 迎接挑战；站起来应对挑战
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，表示决定迎接生活挑战，rise用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must rise to the challenges of the new century.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须迎接新世纪的挑战。
vocab_pack.from_passage: So I decided to rise to life challenges.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to combine or blend with something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词mixed with作定语修饰periods，表示与…混合的时期。
vocab_pack.example_en: The recipe mixes flour with sugar and eggs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 食谱将面粉与糖和鸡蛋混合。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Then came periods of calm mixed with interruptions of relapses

vocab_pack.definition_en: a break or pause in continuity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，与介词of连用，表示旧病复发的打断。
vocab_pack.example_en: There were several interruptions during the meeting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 会议中出现了几次打断。
vocab_pack.from_passage: interruptions of relapses

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remember something from the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式recalled，后接宾语those awful words。
vocab_pack.example_en: She could recall the exact words he said.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她能回忆起他说的确切话语。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I have recalled those awful words through my half-a-century battles.

vocab_pack.definition_en: lasting or relating to fifty years
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词作定语，修饰battles。
vocab_pack.example_en: He has half-a-century of experience in teaching.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他有半个世纪的教龄。
vocab_pack.from_passage: through my half-a-century battles

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: allowed them to leave me hopeless
vocab_pack.definition_en: to permit someone to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式allowed，后接宾语them（指那些话），不定式to leave me hopeless作宾补。
vocab_pack.example_en: My parents never allow me to stay out late.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我父母从不允许我晚归。
vocab_pack.from_passage: But through my faith, I never allowed them to leave me hopeless.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to feel without hope
vocab_pack.grammar_note: leave + 宾语 + 形容词hopeless作宾补，文中用于不定式 to leave me hopeless。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bad news left him hopeless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 坏消息让他感到绝望。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I never allowed them to leave me hopeless.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a chance to discover or try new ways or possibilities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中作为become的表语，to explore new paths是不定式作定语修饰opportunity。
vocab_pack.example_en: College provides an opportunity to explore new paths in life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大学提供了探索人生新道路的机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Every incident in life becomes an opportunity to explore new paths

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make oneself remember or think about something, especially a quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词remind + 反身代词myself + how引导的形容词从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: He reminded himself how lucky he was.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他提醒自己有多幸运。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to remind myself how strong and determined I am.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue moving or doing something without stopping
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中用于疑问句How do you keep going，表示如何坚持。
vocab_pack.example_en: Despite the difficulties, she kept going.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管困难重重，她还是继续前进。
vocab_pack.from_passage: How do you keep going and not give up ?

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop trying; to surrender
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中与keep going并列，否定形式not give up。
vocab_pack.example_en: Never give up on your dreams.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 永远不要放弃你的梦想。
vocab_pack.from_passage: How do you keep going and not give up ?

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be transported mentally to a past time or place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，was taken back to，表示我被带回到那个场景。
vocab_pack.example_en: The smell of the sea took me back to my childhood.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 海的气味让我回到了童年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Instantly, I was taken back to that scene of my youth

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have or contain a different significance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式held，主语those hurtful words，宾语new meaning。
vocab_pack.example_en: The song has held new meaning for me since that day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 自那天起，这首歌对我有了新的含义。
vocab_pack.from_passage: those hurtful words suddenly held new meaning in my heart.

vocab_pack.term: a smile formed upon one's lips
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: A smile formed upon my lips
vocab_pack.definition_en: a smile appeared on someone's lips
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式formed，upon相当于on，表示在嘴唇上形成。
vocab_pack.example_en: A gentle smile formed upon her lips.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一抹温柔的微笑浮上她的嘴角。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A smile formed upon my lips as I turned to face my friend.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to rotate one's body in order to look at someone directly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式turned，后接不定式to face表目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: She turned to face the audience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她转身面对观众。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as I turned to face my friend.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to live or exist despite danger or difficulty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语I，表示我活下来。
vocab_pack.example_en: Thanks to the rescue team, they survived the earthquake.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多亏了救援队，他们在地震中幸存下来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I survive because I FIGHT LIKE A GIRL.

vocab_pack.definition_en: having a strong desire to do something and not letting difficulties stop you
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，与strong并列作表语，用于how引导的宾语从句中。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is determined to succeed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她决心要成功。
vocab_pack.from_passage: how strong and determined I am

section_2_word_form.passage:
The Yuxu Palace in Ne Zha 2 fascinates the audience with its delicate colors and structure, paying tribute to (致敬) Emperor Song Huizong's famous painting Ruihe Tu collected in the Liaoning Provincial Museum. Beyond the museum's treasures, Liaoning's culture extends over [56] (century). The Hongshan Culture (4700—2900 BC), discovered in western Liaoning, reveals stone carvings of dragons and phoenixes, suggesting this land brought China's earliest [57] (spirit) symbols into existence. The Three Yan Kingdoms tombs in Chaoyang showcase splendid gold crowns and glassware from the 5th century, [58] (prove) Liaoning was a crossroads of Eurasian civilizations.
Modern Liaoning breathes life into its past. With holographic (全息的) exhibits displaying Nurhaci's rise, visitors walk [59] Manchu-style architecture at the Shenyang Imperial Palace. Meanwhile, the White Pagoda in Liaoyang, built in 1189, stands as a silent guardian of Liao Dynasty Buddhism, whose brick carvings [60] (view) as representation of a bygone era.
Yet at the core of Liaoning's crown jewels [61] (be) its people. Folk artists in villages near Anshan still craft Northeast Tiger paper cuttings, [62] tradition symbolizing courage, [63] chefs in Dalian reinvent royal dishes in the Qing Dynasty. From the whispers of the Liao River to the laughter in Shenyang's night markets, every corner is designed [64] (tell) a story.
As cranes (鹤) rise in both art and reality over Liaoning, [65] they carry is not just beauty but the soul of a civilization that continues to inspire people.

questions.explanation: 句意为“辽宁的文化跨越了几个世纪”。extend over 意为“延续，跨越”，century 此处为可数名词且表示复数概念，故变为复数形式 centuries。
questions.supplement: 正确形(centuries)：语境句：The majestic castle has stood here for centuries. 固定搭配：for centuries, over the centuries。原词century其它变形：centennial(n./adj. 百年纪念/百年的)

questions.explanation: 此处修饰名词 symbols（象征），需将名词 spirit 转化为形容词 spiritual，表示“精神上的（象征）”。
knowledge_points: 词性转换（名词转形容词）
questions.supplement: 正确形(spiritual)：语境句：He traveled to India on a spiritual journey to find himself. 固定搭配：spiritual needs, spiritual leader。原词spirit其它变形：spirited(adj. 精神饱满的), spiritually(adv. 精神上地)

questions.explanation: 本句主语为 The Three Yan Kingdoms tombs，谓语动词为 showcase。逗号后无连词，此处需填非谓语动词。主语 tombs 与 prove 之间为主动关系，且表示顺理成章的自然结果或伴随状况，故使用现在分词 proving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(proving)：语境句：She passed the extremely difficult test, proving her great ability. 固定搭配：prove to be, prove oneself。原词prove其它变形：proof(n. 证据), proven(adj. 已被证实的)

questions.explanation: 句意为“游客们漫步穿梭于沈阳故宫的满族风格建筑中”。walk through 意为“穿行于……”，符合在古建筑群中游览的语境。（填 among 或 around 也可接受）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(through)：语境句：We took a relaxing walk through the beautiful ancient town. 固定搭配：walk through, look through

questions.explanation: 在定语从句 whose brick carvings ___ as representation 中，主语 brick carvings 为复数，与 view 之间为被动关系；且全文叙述的是一种客观事实或现状，应用一般现在时。因此填被动语态 are viewed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are viewed)：语境句：His ambitious actions are viewed as a threat to national security. 固定搭配：view...as, in view of。原词view其它变形：viewer(n. 观众), viewpoint(n. 观点)

questions.explanation: 本句为完全倒装句。表地点的介词短语 At the core of Liaoning's crown jewels 位于句首，其后紧跟系动词，真正的主语是其后的 its people（它的人民）。people 作为集合名词表示复数概念，故系动词填 are。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are)：语境句：At the top of the steep hill are two old pine trees. 固定搭配：be central to, be core to

questions.explanation: 名词短语 tradition symbolizing courage 作前文东北虎剪纸的同位语，表示“（这是）一项象征着勇气的传统”，泛指类别，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：She is a dedicated teacher with ten years of experience. 固定搭配：a lot of, a kind of

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，前半句讲述鞍山的手工艺人制作剪纸，后半句讲述大连的厨师复原清代宫廷菜，两者是同时发生或并列对比的两项具有地方特色的文化传承活动。填 while（而，然而，同时）最佳；填并列连词 and 也可。
questions.supplement: 正确形(while)：语境句：Some people like to drink tea, while others prefer strong coffee. 固定搭配：for a while, once in a while

questions.explanation: 句意：每一个角落都被设计来讲述一个故事。be designed to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“被设计用来做某事”，不定式表目的。
knowledge_points: 非谓语动词（动词不定式）
questions.supplement: 正确形(to tell)：语境句：The intensive course is designed to help beginners learn coding quickly. 固定搭配：tell a story, tell the truth。原词tell其它变形：telling(adj. 生动的/反映真实情况的), teller(n. 出纳员/讲述者)

questions.explanation: 此处为引导主语从句的连接词，并在从句中作谓语动词 carry 的宾语，意为“它们所承载的事物”。因此填关系代词 what。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：What we desperately need right now is more time and patience. 固定搭配：what if, no matter what

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract and hold the attention of someone by being extremely interesting or charming
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数形式（fascinates），主语The Yuxu Palace，表示客观事实。
vocab_pack.example_en: Ancient Chinese architecture never fails to fascinate visitors from around the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 中国古代建筑总能吸引来自世界各地的游客。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The Yuxu Palace in Ne Zha 2 fascinates the audience with its delicate colors and structure...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to express respect or admiration for someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词短语（paying tribute to），作状语，表示伴随动作。整个短语的动词原形为pay。
vocab_pack.example_en: The design of the new library pays tribute to traditional Chinese garden aesthetics.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新图书馆的设计向中国传统园林美学致敬。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...paying tribute to Emperor Song Huizong's famous painting Ruihe Tu...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring together objects from different places; to assemble
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去分词（collected）作后置定语，修饰painting，表示被动关系（被收藏）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum collects artifacts from various dynasties to showcase the region's history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆收藏了各个朝代的文物以展示该地区的历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...Emperor Song Huizong's famous painting Ruihe Tu collected in the Liaoning Provincial Museum.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cover a period of time or an area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数（extends over），主语Liaoning's culture，表示延续性事实。
vocab_pack.example_en: The influence of the Silk Road extends over many centuries and continents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 丝绸之路的影响跨越了许多个世纪和大陆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Beyond the museum's treasures, Liaoning's culture extends over centuries.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a period of 100 years
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式（centuries），与over搭配表示跨越多个世纪。复数作名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Great Wall has stood for more than twenty centuries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 长城已经屹立了二十多个世纪。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...Liaoning's culture extends over centuries.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to find something unexpectedly or for the first time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去分词（discovered）作定语，修饰Hongshan Culture，表示被动（被发现的）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Archaeologists discovered ancient tombs dating back to the Neolithic period.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考古学家发现了可追溯到新石器时代的古墓。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The Hongshan Culture (4700—2900 BC), discovered in western Liaoning...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make known or show something that was previously hidden or unknown
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词（revealing）作结果状语，表示The Hongshan Culture被发现的结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: Recent excavations reveal the advanced craftsmanship of early civilizations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 最近的发掘揭示了早期文明的先进工艺。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...revealing stone carvings of dragons and phoenixes...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put forward an idea or evidence that implies something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词（suggesting）作伴随状语，进一步说明stone carvings所暗示的信息。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient artifacts suggest that trade routes connected distant regions long ago.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些古代文物表明，贸易路线在很久以前就连接了遥远的地区。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...suggesting this land brought China's earliest spiritual symbols into existence.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to appear or be created
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去式（brought），表示过去发生的动作。宾语this land，后面接China's earliest spiritual symbols。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Industrial Revolution brought many new inventions into existence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工业革命使许多新发明问世。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...suggesting this land brought China's earliest spiritual symbols into existence.

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to religion, the soul, or the spirit rather than physical things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为形容词原形（spiritual），修饰symbols，作定语。源自名词spirit的词形变化。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many traditional dances have deep spiritual meaning for the local people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多传统舞蹈对当地人有着深刻的精神意义。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...China's earliest spiritual symbols...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show that something is true or certain by providing evidence
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词（proving）作结果状语，表示gold crowns and glassware证明了这一事实。
vocab_pack.example_en: The fossil evidence proves that dinosaurs once roamed this area.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 化石证据证明恐龙曾在这个地区出没。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...proving Liaoning was a crossroads of Eurasian civilizations.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a place where two or more roads cross; an important point of intersection or meeting
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为单数形式（crossroads）作表语，与was a构成系表结构。该词单复数同形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city served as a cultural crossroads between East and West.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市是东西方文化的交汇点。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...Liaoning was a crossroads of Eurasian civilizations.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring vitality, energy, or new spirit to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数（breathes），主语Modern Liaoning，表示客观事实。短语整体作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The director managed to breathe life into a centuries-old legend through modern animation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 导演通过现代动画技术为这个古老的传说注入了生命。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Modern Liaoning breathes life into its past.

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to a three-dimensional image created by holography
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为形容词原形（holographic），修饰exhibits，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum uses holographic displays to bring ancient artifacts to life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆使用全息展示让古代文物复活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With holographic exhibits displaying Nurhaci's rise...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show something to people for them to see or experience
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词（displaying）作定语修饰exhibits，表主动（全息展品展示）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The gallery displays works of contemporary artists from around the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 画廊展示来自世界各地的当代艺术家的作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...holographic exhibits displaying Nurhaci's rise...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to walk into and across a place, especially in a deliberate manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时复数（walk through），主语visitors，表示一般性动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: Visitors can walk through the reconstructed streets of the Tang Dynasty.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 游客可以穿过重建的唐代街道。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...visitors walk through Manchu-style architecture at the Shenyang Imperial Palace.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to construct or create something by assembling materials
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去分词（built）用于被动结构（was built？原文是“built in 1189”，实际上是定语？仔细看：“the White Pagoda in Liaoyang, built in 1189, stands...” 这里的built是过去分词作定语，相当于which was built。表示被动。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient temple was built entirely of local stone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古庙完全用当地石材建造。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...the White Pagoda in Liaoyang, built in 1189...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to exist or be situated in a particular role or capacity; to serve as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数（stands as），主语the White Pagoda，表示状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The monument stands as a reminder of the city's glorious past.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座纪念碑作为这座城市辉煌过去的见证。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...the White Pagoda in Liaoyang... stands as a silent guardian of Liao Dynasty Buddhism.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person or thing that protects or keeps something safe
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为单数名词（guardian），前面有a，作表语。silent作定语修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient wall served as a guardian of the city against invaders.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 古老的城墙作为城市的守卫者抵御入侵者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...stands as a silent guardian of Liao Dynasty Buddhism.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consider or regard someone or something in a particular way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为被动语态一般现在时复数（are viewed as），主语brick carvings，表示被看作。view为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: These ancient coins are viewed as valuable historical artifacts by experts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些古钱币被专家视为有价值的历史文物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...whose brick carvings are viewed as representation of a bygone era.

vocab_pack.definition_en: belonging to an earlier time; past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为形容词（bygone），修饰era，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The photographs capture the charm of a bygone era.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些照片捕捉了过去时代的魅力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...representation of a bygone era.

vocab_pack.definition_en: at the most important or central part of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为介词短语，位于句首，与后面的are构成倒装结构（at the core of Liaoning's crown jewels are its people）。强调位置。
vocab_pack.example_en: At the core of the debate lies the question of resource allocation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 辩论的核心是资源分配问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Yet at the core of Liaoning's crown jewels are its people.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the most valuable or important part of something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 最珍贵的东西，核心资产
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数（crown jewels），作介词of的宾语，比喻意义。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient palace is considered the crown jewel of the city's heritage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古老的宫殿被认为是该市遗产中最珍贵的部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...Liaoning's crown jewels...

vocab_pack.definition_en: an artist who creates traditional art reflecting the culture of a particular community
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数（folk artists），作主语，表示一类人。
vocab_pack.example_en: Folk artists often use natural materials to create their works.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 民间艺术家常用天然材料创作作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Folk artists in villages near Anshan still craft Northeast Tiger paper cuttings...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something skillfully by hand
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称复数（craft），主语Folk artists，表示经常性动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: Artisans craft beautiful pottery using techniques passed down for generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工匠们使用世代相传的技术制作精美的陶器。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Folk artists in villages near Anshan still craft Northeast Tiger paper cuttings...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be a symbol of something; to represent or stand for
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词（symbolizing）作定语（或非限制性定语？修饰tradition），表示“象征勇气的传统”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dragon often symbolizes power and strength in Chinese culture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 龙在中国文化中常象征权力和力量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...a tradition symbolizing courage...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change something so much that it seems entirely new; to remake
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称复数（reinvent），主语chefs，表示经常性动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: Modern chefs often reinvent traditional dishes with a contemporary twist.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 现代厨师常常用现代手法重新诠释传统菜肴。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...chefs in Dalian reinvent royal dishes in the Qing Dynasty.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be intended or planned for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为被动语态一般现在时单数（is designed to），主语every corner，表示被设计用来。后面接不定式。
vocab_pack.example_en: This museum is designed to educate visitors about local history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座博物馆旨在教育游客了解当地历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...every corner is designed to tell a story.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to narrate or relate a sequence of events
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式（to tell a story），与be designed to连用，表示目的。tell为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Every painting in the gallery tells a story of its own.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 画廊里的每幅画都有自己的故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...to tell a story.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large bird with long legs and neck, often seen as a symbol of longevity in East Asia
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数（cranes），作主语rise的发出者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Cranes are often depicted in Chinese paintings as symbols of good fortune.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鹤在中国画中常被描绘为吉祥的象征。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As cranes rise in both art and reality over Liaoning...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep doing something without stopping
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数（continues），主语a civilization，表示持续状态。后面接不定式to inspire。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient tradition continues to influence modern design.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个古老的传统继续影响着现代设计。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...a civilization that continues to inspire people.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give someone the desire, confidence, or enthusiasm to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动词原形（inspire），位于不定式to后，表示目的。是continues的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Great art can inspire generations to pursue creativity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 伟大的艺术可以激励一代代人追求创造力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...continues to inspire people.
